```{r}
# ============================================================
# SBS mutational signature annotation from PCGR msigs files
# ============================================================

msig_dir <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/WES/Downstream/PCGR/Mutational_Signature_PCGR"

sbs_out_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "SBS_signature_annotation")
dir.create(sbs_out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

msig_files <- list.files(
  path = msig_dir,
  pattern = "\\.pcgr\\.grch38\\.msigs\\.tsv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

if (length(msig_files) == 0) {
  stop("No *.pcgr.grch38.msigs.tsv files found in: ", msig_dir)
}

message("[INFO] Found ", length(msig_files), " msigs files")

bucket_map <- function(sig) {
  sig <- toupper(sig)

  if (sig %in% c("SBS1", "SBS5")) return("Clock-like/Aging")
  if (sig %in% c("SBS2", "SBS13")) return("APOBEC/AID")
  if (sig == "SBS3") return("HR deficiency")
  if (sig %in% c("SBS6", "SBS15", "SBS21", "SBS26", "SBS44")) return("MMR deficiency")
  if (sig %in% c("SBS10A", "SBS10B")) return("POLE proofreading defect")
  if (sig %in% c("SBS7A", "SBS29", "SBS90", "SBS18", "SBS9")) return("Exposure-related")

  return("Unknown/Uncharacterized")
}

msig_dt <- rbindlist(lapply(msig_files, function(f) {
  dt <- fread(f, sep = "\t", header = TRUE, data.table = TRUE)

  needed <- c("sample_id", "signature_id", "prop_signature")
  missing_cols <- setdiff(needed, names(dt))

  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    stop("Missing columns in ", f, ": ", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "))
  }

  dt <- dt[, ..needed]

  sample_from_file <- sub("\\.pcgr\\.grch38\\.msigs\\.tsv$", "", basename(f))
  dt[is.na(sample_id) | sample_id == "", sample_id := sample_from_file]

  dt[, Source_File := basename(f)]

  return(dt)
}), use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)

msig_dt[, prop_signature := as.numeric(prop_signature)]
msig_dt[, Biological_Categories := vapply(signature_id, bucket_map, character(1))]

fwrite(
  msig_dt,
  file = file.path(sbs_out_dir, "PCGR_msigs_all_samples_with_buckets.tsv"),
  sep = "\t"
)

head(msig_dt)
```
```{r}
# ============================================================
# Sum SBS signatures into biological categories
# ============================================================

cat_levels <- c(
  "Clock-like/Aging",
  "APOBEC/AID",
  "HR deficiency",
  "MMR deficiency",
  "POLE proofreading defect",
  "Exposure-related",
  "Unknown/Uncharacterized"
)

bucket_sum <- msig_dt[
  ,
  .(bucket_prop = sum(prop_signature, na.rm = TRUE)),
  by = .(sample_id, Biological_Categories)
]

bucket_sum[, total := sum(bucket_prop), by = sample_id]
bucket_sum[, Relative_contribution := bucket_prop / total]

complete_dt <- CJ(
  sample_id = unique(bucket_sum$sample_id),
  Biological_Categories = cat_levels,
  unique = TRUE
)

sbs_long <- merge(
  complete_dt,
  bucket_sum[, .(sample_id, Biological_Categories, Relative_contribution)],
  by = c("sample_id", "Biological_Categories"),
  all.x = TRUE
)

sbs_long[is.na(Relative_contribution), Relative_contribution := 0]

sbs_long[, Biological_Categories := factor(Biological_Categories, levels = cat_levels)]

fwrite(
  sbs_long,
  file = file.path(sbs_out_dir, "SBS_Merged_Categories_for_Tier1_samples.tsv"),
  sep = "\t"
)

head(sbs_long)

# ============================================================
# Integrated mutation heatmap with SBS bottom annotation
# ============================================================

breast_genes <- c(
  "ERBB2", "FGFR1", "NF1", "GNAS", "PAK1", "PIK3CA", "PTEN",
  "AKT1", "GATA3", "ESR1", "FOXA1", "ARID1A", "TBX3", "MYC",
  "MCL1", "MAP3K1", "RECQL4", "RARA", "CCND1", "CDH1", "TP53",
  "BRCA1", "RICTOR", "FAT1", "JAK3", "CIC", "ARID2"
)

present_breast_genes <- breast_genes[
  breast_genes %in% maf_nonsilent@gene.summary$Hugo_Symbol
]

present_breast_genes
```
```{r}
# Create mutation matrix for oncoPrint-style heatmap

# Make sure Variant_Classification is character
mut_dt[, Variant_Classification := as.character(Variant_Classification)]

collapse_mut <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- unique(x)
  x <- x[!is.na(x) & x != ""]

  if (length(x) == 0) {
    return("")
  }

  if (length(x) > 1) {
    return("Multi_Hit")
  }

  return(as.character(x[1]))
}

mut_collapsed <- mut_dt[
  ,
  .(Alteration = as.character(collapse_mut(Variant_Classification))),
  by = .(Hugo_Symbol, Tumor_Sample_Barcode)
]

mut_mat <- matrix(
  "",
  nrow = length(present_breast_genes),
  ncol = length(sample_order),
  dimnames = list(present_breast_genes, sample_order)
)

for (i in seq_len(nrow(mut_collapsed))) {
  gene <- mut_collapsed$Hugo_Symbol[i]
  sample <- mut_collapsed$Tumor_Sample_Barcode[i]
  alt <- mut_collapsed$Alteration[i]

  mut_mat[gene, sample] <- alt
}

# Remove genes with no mutation after filtering
mut_mat <- mut_mat[rowSums(mut_mat != "") > 0, , drop = FALSE]

```

```{r}
# Prepare SBS matrix for bottom annotation

sbs_wide <- dcast(
  sbs_long_matched,
  sample_id ~ Biological_Categories,
  value.var = "Relative_contribution",
  fill = 0
)

sbs_wide <- sbs_wide[match(sample_order, sample_id)]

sbs_bar_mat <- as.matrix(sbs_wide[, cat_levels, with = FALSE])
rownames(sbs_bar_mat) <- sbs_wide$sample_id

# Mutation colors

mut_cols <- c(
  "Missense_Mutation" = "#4E79A7",
  "Nonsense_Mutation" = "#E15759",
  "Frame_Shift_Del" = "#F28E2B",
  "Frame_Shift_Ins" = "#FF9D9A",
  "In_Frame_Del" = "#59A14F",
  "In_Frame_Ins" = "#8CD17D",
  "Splice_Site" = "#B07AA1",
  "Translation_Start_Site" = "#EDC948",
  "Nonstop_Mutation" = "#9C755F",
  "Multi_Hit" = "#000000"
)
```

```{r}
# Keep only alteration classes present in the matrix
present_alterations <- unique(unlist(strsplit(mut_mat[mut_mat != ""], ";")))
present_alterations <- present_alterations[present_alterations %in% names(mut_cols)]
mut_cols_present <- mut_cols[present_alterations]

alter_fun <- list(
  background = function(x, y, w, h) {
    grid.rect(x, y, w, h, gp = gpar(fill = "#F2F2F2", col = "white"))
  }
)

for (alteration in names(mut_cols_present)) {
  alter_fun[[alteration]] <- local({
    alt <- alteration
    function(x, y, w, h) {
      grid.rect(
        x, y,
        w * 0.9,
        h * 0.9,
        gp = gpar(fill = mut_cols_present[alt], col = NA)
      )
    }
  })
}
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# SBS bottom annotation with manual SBS legend
# ============================================================

bottom_ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  SBS = anno_barplot(
    sbs_bar_mat,
    gp = gpar(fill = sbs_colors[colnames(sbs_bar_mat)], col = NA),
    bar_width = 1,
    height = unit(2.0, "cm"),
    axis_param = list(
      side = "left",
      labels_rot = 0
    )
  ),
  annotation_name_side = "left",
  which = "column"
)

# Manual SBS legend
sbs_lgd <- Legend(
  title = "SBS category",
  at = names(sbs_colors),
  legend_gp = gpar(fill = sbs_colors),
  labels = names(sbs_colors)
)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Oncoplot
# ============================================================

ht <- oncoPrint(
  mut_mat,
  alter_fun = alter_fun,
  col = mut_cols_present,
  get_type = function(x) strsplit(x, ";")[[1]],
  bottom_annotation = bottom_ha,
  show_column_names = TRUE,
  column_labels = sample_order,   # original sample IDs
  column_names_rot = 60,
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 6),
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 9),
  heatmap_legend_param = list(title = "Mutation type"),
  column_title = "Tier 1 common variants with SBS bottom annotation",
  pct_side = "right",
  row_names_side = "left"
)
```
